tasks.title: Review and Verify Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Review the existing mobile responsive CSS implementation and ensure complete mobile responsiveness:

1. Read existing CSS files:
   - src/components/Calculator.css (check media queries and responsive layout)
   - src/components/Display.css (verify text scaling and display sizing)
   - src/components/Button.css (check button sizing for touch targets)
   - src/App.css (review overall responsive structure)

2. Verify and fix media queries for:
   - Small mobile (320px - 480px): ensure buttons are touch-friendly, no overflow
   - Medium mobile/tablet (481px - 768px): optimize layout and spacing
   - Desktop (769px+): proper sizing and centering

3. Ensure responsive requirements:
   - No horizontal scrolling at any viewport width
   - Minimum 44px touch targets for buttons on mobile
   - Readable font sizes (minimum 16px for display on mobile)
   - Proper spacing and padding that scales with viewport
   - Calculator centered and properly sized on all devices

4. Write responsive tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx:
   - Add tests that verify responsive behavior
   - Test component rendering at different viewport sizes if applicable
   - Ensure tests validate key responsive features

5. Visual verification:
   - Start dev server (npm run dev)
   - Use Playwright to capture screenshots at: 375x667 (mobile), 768x1024 (tablet), 1920x1080 (desktop)
   - Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/
   - Verify layout correctness, button sizes, and text readability in screenshots
   - Stop dev server when done

6. Fix any issues discovered during review
acceptance_criteria: All CSS files have appropriate media queries for mobile, tablet, and desktop
No horizontal scrolling on any device size (320px and up)
Buttons have minimum 44px touch targets on mobile
Display text is readable on all devices (minimum 16px on mobile)
Calculator is properly centered and sized on all viewports
Screenshots confirm visual correctness at all three viewport sizes

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Comprehensively validate that the calculator is fully responsive across all device sizes:

1. Run the test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, including responsive tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
   - Review test output for any responsive-related failures

2. Visual validation using Playwright:
   - Start dev server (npm run dev)
   - Test calculator at mobile viewport (375x667)
   - Test calculator at tablet viewport (768x1024)
   - Test calculator at desktop viewport (1920x1080)
   - Capture screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/qa/ for each viewport
   - Stop dev server when done

3. Verify visual requirements:
   - No horizontal scrolling at any viewport
   - All buttons are properly sized and accessible
   - Display text is readable and properly sized
   - Calculator layout maintains proper proportions
   - No content overflow or cut-off elements

4. Functional validation:
   - Verify calculator operations work at all viewport sizes
   - Check that all buttons are clickable and responsive
   - Ensure display updates correctly at all sizes
acceptance_criteria: All unit tests pass without errors
Calculator displays correctly at mobile viewport (375x667)
Calculator displays correctly at tablet viewport (768x1024)
Calculator displays correctly at desktop viewport (1920x1080)
No horizontal scrolling at any viewport size
All calculator functions work correctly at all viewport sizes
Screenshots confirm proper responsive layout at all tested viewports
